sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Clicked "remind me later" thirty days ago
Now the meter's running and the emails flow
Quarter to three, my phone lights up the room
"Thanks for your purchase" — man, I never ordered you

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: Refresh, refresh, tell me where it's at
Little truck icon and it's circling the map

sections.name: Chorus
lines: It's out for delivery, it's coming for me
Nine ninety-nine and a convenience fee
I never ordered it but it's on its way
Out for delivery, arriving today

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Tracking number for a box I never packed
Three stops away, it's been three stops all day
Driver's in my neighborhood, just not my street
Just like my money, it ain't coming back to me

The truck is parked right on my street
